card.name: Saline concentration in IV diluent names
card.fires_on: The decimal point, percent sign or space inside a sodium chloride strength such as 0.9% or 0.45%. It appears in lists of IV diluents and infusion fluids.

modes.label: Decimal point in strength
modes.description: The point after 0 in 0.9% or 0.45% sodium chloride.

modes.label: Space or percent sign before/after strength
modes.description: The space before a saline strength or the percent sign after it, in diluent lists.

card.plain: It fires on the number format of saline strengths like 0.9% or 0.45% in lists of IV fluids used for dilution.
